layers.name: Flowing engine-turned cheek ground / bench chasing

recipe.name: Solstice — sun seal / Delft clay
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Imported-stock master with axial solar relief and isolated cheek ornament. Z=0 parting, opposed Z withdrawal, molded bore. Cast all ornament except the explicitly marked fine finish and inscription. Dress seam/gate and polish reserved borders. Confirm shrink, sand support, filling, and actual release with a physical trial; channel layout is preliminary.
